Evidence: [index.ts:1403](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jira/blob/7ceaabe20725a3d55e614cbc266742fc81d0847b/index.ts#L1403), [index.ts:793](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/cf4fa0adfa5033fea142acbbc94bf39200bf9ec6/index.ts#L793) / [index.ts:965](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/cf4fa0adfa5033fea142acbbc94bf39200bf9ec6/index.ts#L965), [index.ts:1925](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-github/blob/d772360c1a099b968908f86026c1cb53c1a499f8/index.ts#L1925) / [index.ts:643](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-github/blob/d772360c1a099b968908f86026c1cb53c1a499f8/index.ts#L643).

Problem: provider connectors each implement cursor/page traversal, missing/repeated cursor checks, source limit accounting and request retry classification. Core paginateQueryRows paginates an already materialized local result; query/read-output cursors are PM transport contracts. executeEmbeddingBatchesWithRetry is specific to embedding batches. None supplies a generic external connection traversal contract. Draft API: caller-provided fetchPage/decodePage callbacks with deterministic row identity, explicit requested source ceiling, progress/deadline/work limits, duplicate/cycling-cursor refusal and complete/limited receipts; optional retry policy must honor Retry-After and never retry non-idempotent writes without an explicit idempotency contract. Keep provider auth, REST/GraphQL decoding and status translation in each connector. Acceptance: repeated/empty intermediate cursors, rate limits, cancellation and partial source limits produce truthful receipts before any import transaction writes.


Source: a read-only audit of 30 fleet extensions against the exported SDK of @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.10.23 (3,188 exported names); each of the three cited packages re-implements this primitive today.
GH-1566: provide bounded external-page traversal for connector extensions
External report: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1566. Revalidate the reported 2026.10.23 behavior against the checkout before implementation.
Provide transport-neutral page traversal with source ceilings and truthful completion receipts; reject cursor cycles; exercise cancellation and bounded retries without retrying non-idempotent writes
